title: Understanding Working Capital Management for Businesses
description: A practical, India-specific introduction to working capital, built for founders, treasury teams, HR and L&D professionals, and employees outside finance whose everyday decisions lock up or release a company's money. Learn to read the working capital lines on a balance sheet, tell gross, net and operating working capital apart, and calculate liquidity ratios and the working capital cycle step by step. See why FMCG, retail, capital goods, pharma and IT companies look so different, and track real trends on screener.in. Understand working capital policy, permanent vs temporary needs, and how to estimate requirement. Get hands-on with credit policy, receivables ageing, EOQ and ABC analysis, supplier terms and the MSME 45-day payment rule. Learn how Indian banks set drawing power, how cash credit, WCDL, commercial paper, factoring and TReDS compare, and finish by linking working capital to growth and valuation, spotting red flags, and fixing a working capital crunch in a case study.
